decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA ($82,558), current pay statement (annualizes to about $84,400) and employment letter ($86,034) support the stated $82,500.
The $34,114 balance is less than the $40,800 down payment, so funds do not cover the down payment and closing costs.
Appraised value of $459,000 from a panel appraiser does not support the $510,000 purchase price.
Fixed-term contract renewed continuously since 2025-02-02 (about 20 months); policy does not define a stable history, so this needs reviewer judgment.
GDS about 28.8% and TDS about 35.4% on the $6,875 monthly income are within limits, with score 793 and liabilities matching the bureau.
